messages:
Asha (CS): AcornHealth wants a clinical-notes summarizer onboarded. Must be private (VPC/on-prem), HSM keys, no persistent user logs. Renewal in ~6w so this is priority.
Liam (Infra): Ok. Need HSM vendor/model and whether they want our Private control plane or fully customer-managed onprem. Also GPU sizing for a 7B quant model.
Devon (ML): We need a sanitized sample prompt set and expected summary lengths. Plan: safety eval + hallucination/regression checks. PHI redaction tests required.
Renee (PM): Infra is tight. Can we do a minimal dedicated-hosted in their VPC as an interim that meets "no egress"?
Asha (CS): Customer insists on zero-telemetry to third parties. Private/VPC only. They want a canary 2 weeks after artifact handoff.
Onboard Bot: New onboarding created  CS-8124  Asha (CS)
Liam (Infra): If ML hands over compiled artifact + quant profile by Fri EOD, infra can provision VPC peering + HSM onboarding in ~10 business days. Need Thales details if that's what they use.
Devon (ML): Eval plan snapshot: 5k prompt-target pairs, hallucination threshold <2%, PHI-detection pass, p50 latency <250ms @ 512ctx. Will spin up harness once sample arrives.
Asha (CS): Action items: I will get sanitized prompts and HSM contact. Renee to tag renewal owner Susan.
Susan (AM): On renewal watch. Please ping me if canary slips.
Renee (PM): I'll mark CRM "at-risk" and schedule a Wed enablement call with their infra lead.
Devon (ML): I'll post preliminary eval results here when ready.
Liam (Infra): Drafting logging policy: disable raw input persistence; only aggregated metrics. Will share PR.
Asha (CS): Thanks team :thumbsup:
